content: General monorepo/Yarn CI guidance (not Theia-specific): cache the Yarn cache directory (not just node_modules) and Yarn's install-state.gz; teams report yarn->pnpm migrations cutting install time 6min->1.5min, and Turbo-style task caching cutting monorepo build CI time 70%. Theia's own start command runs a filesystem watcher across many files -> increase OS inotify watch limits on Linux to avoid ENOSPC.
